title: Colosseum 1.1.6
summary: Keyboard-first navigation, multilingual Tankoyomi sources, more durable account state, and a stricter Windows release gate.

highlights.title: Arrows keep moving
highlights.body: Spatial navigation now follows visual direction across worlds and continues through overflowing content instead of stopping at the viewport edge.

highlights.title: Multilingual chapter sources
highlights.body: Persisted language configuration, region-safe routing, identity-safe matching, bounded provider fallback, and real-image qualification strengthen Tankoyomi chapter mode.

highlights.title: State survives the rough edges
highlights.body: Remembered sessions, sync replay identity, profile replacement, activity migration, and attachment recovery received another durability pass.

highlights.title: Less work on the interaction path
highlights.body: Recurring background work and startup sequencing were tightened to reduce GUI-thread contention and make regressions measurable.

highlights.title: Stremio startup recovers
highlights.body: The bundled stream-server launch path can recover from failed startup state instead of leaving Theatre stranded behind it.

highlights.title: One-time trust reset
highlights.body: Colosseum 1.1.6 establishes a new update-signing trust root. Install this release manually once when coming from 1.1.5 or earlier; automatic updates resume normally from 1.1.6 onward.
